title: History of the Kingdom of the Orcsen: How the Barbarian Orcish Nation Came to Burn Down the Peaceful Elfland
titleRomaji: Orcsen Oukokushi: Yaban na Orc no Kuni wa, Ika ni Shite Heiwa na Elf no Kuni wo Yakiharau ni Itatta ka
titleEnglish: History of the Kingdom of the Orcsen: How the Barbarian Orcish Nation Came to Burn Down the Peaceful Elfland
titleNative: オルクセン王国史 ～野蛮なオークの国は、如何にして平和なエルフの国を焼き払うに至ったか～
synonyms: History of the Kingdom of the Orcsen - How the Barbarian Orcish Nation Came To Burn Down The Peaceful Elfland
synopsis: Betrayed by their brethren, a dark elf chief must do whatever it takes to save her people-even trusting orcs. After their allies violently attack, chieftain Dineru of the dark elves commands her remaining people to flee, leading them into Orcsen, a land of orcs. Despite being enemies, Dineru and her clan are welcomed into the kingdom. Dineru makes a deal with the orc king, Gustav, asking for supplies so she can return to fight, but Gustav has other plans. Fighting alongside the dark elves, Gustav helps lead Dineru to victory and offers them a permanent home in the kingdom. Will Dineru and her people find peace, or is this the beginning of a deadly future? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Oosaki-san to Komori-san
synopsis: A pure love story between two people with a 50cm height difference and mismatched appearances and personalities. The new part-timer is... a child!?!? Osaki-san is tall and has a poker face, making her seem intimidating at first glance, but she's actually shy and kind. The new employee who comes to Osaki-san's workplace is Komori-san, who is only 147cm tall and very friendly. These two, who are complete opposites in appearance and personality, find themselves drawn to each other...!? Osaki-san is clumsy and a crybaby, yet a go-getter, and Komori-san is oblivious, laid-back, and a gentle, introverted type. What will become of the love between these two, who are complete opposites and have a 50cm height difference...? This is the first installment of a hilarious and heartwarming survival-of-the-fittest (?) romantic comedy about these two quirky girls. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on May 11, 2026.

synopsis: Sara, a mermaid living in the modern world, has been dealing with yokai and humans alike as a “Trader.” To her, humans are merely clients—trusting them with her heart was never an option… One day, a mysterious young man named Sora wanders into her miniature garden. He doesn’t seem like an enemy, but there’s clearly something unusual about him. Sara offers him a deal. However, the one thing Sora truly desires turns out to be none other than Sara herself…!? A cohabitation romance filled with love and secrets begins—all starting from a single “deal”! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis: Albert, the youngest son of the border noble Falconer family, has a secret: he is a reincarnated person from another world. The Falconer family is one of the most skilled fighting families in the border, and he was raised on the battlefield from an early age. One day, at the age of 14, he realizes that this world is exactly like a game he played only once in his previous life. However, his memories of that game are vague. In the end, he was a "mob character" whose name doesn't even appear. As Albert begins to question the meaning of his existence, he decides to enroll at Radford Royal Magic Academy, the setting of the game...!? (Source: Futabasha, translated)
